name.value: West Coast Trail Information & Orientation Centre

description.value: This Parks Canada information and orientation centre serves hikers preparing for the 75-kilometre West Coast Trail, one of British Columbia's most famous multi-day backcountry routes on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The trail passes through the traditional territories of the Huu-ay-aht, Ditidaht, and Pacheedaht First Nations. The centre is located near the Gordon River trailhead at the southern end of the trail.
